title: Contradictory manoeuvre requests from two vessels

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is BRAVO. REQUEST. Alter your course to starboard to pass astern of me. I intend to maintain my present course. Over.
events.expected_response: Acknowledge receipt without treating BRAVO's request as authority to manoeuvre before assessing CHARLIE and the complete encounter.

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is CHARLIE. REQUEST. Alter your course to port to pass astern of me. I intend to maintain my present course. Over.
events.expected_response: Recognise that CHARLIE's request conflicts with BRAVO's earlier request, decline any unsafe negotiated manoeuvre, and choose one independently safe response across both contacts.
events.forbidden_outcome: Following either requested direction without evaluating the simultaneous collision risk created by the other vessel.
